name: Spatial Navigation and Social Cognitive Integration
description: Cross-framework template linking spatial navigation with social brain systems. Cognitive maps encode both physical space and social context, enabling integrated spatial-social reasoning.

key_references.citation: Epstein, R. A., Patai, E. Z., Julian, J. B., & Spiers, H. J. (2017). The cognitive map in humans: Spatial navigation and beyond. Nature Neuroscience, 20(11), 1504-1513.
Tavares, R. M., et al. (2015). A map for social navigation in the human brain. Neuron, 87(1), 231-243.

causal_links.mechanism_summary: Spatial layout activates hippocampal place cells and grid cells in entorhinal cortex
Cognitive map integrates spatial structure with social cue encoding (social affordances)
Integrated spatial-social model guides navigation decisions and social positioning

short_description: Spatial Navigation and Social Cognitive Integration
